description: Use this when a linked golfer asks about their goals, what they're working on, their focus, or how a block of practice went: the active focus goal (the reading, its zone, who set it, the block so far and the before), the long-term goal, goals waiting in the app, and recent goals with the app's outcome (Improved, Held, Not yet, Mastered). Counts are focus swings in the zone out of focus swings with a read. Only call a change real when the outcome says so.

recent.description: How many finished goals to include.
